summary: Complete iOS suggestion-strip gesture and boundary choreography

changes.title: Swipe-onset capsule and dividers
changes.detail: The existing gesture UI callback now activates the same slot-width capsule at swipe onset, even before new words arrive, and restores dividers at gesture completion or cancellation. This is presentation-only and does not alter decoder confidence, word ranking or gesture input.

changes.title: Frame-matched chrome timing and interruption safety
changes.detail: Refine capsule/divider transition to an estimated 33 ms from the 30-fps reference; skip snapshot work when motion is disabled, bound retained glyphs, suppress old-editor motion and remove stale correction highlighting during display-only prediction gaps. No dictionary, voice, settings or other feature changes.
